remarks: Welcome to the highly sought-after Heywood Heights community, where lushly landscaped grounds, a welcoming clubhouse, and a sparkling in-ground pool set the tone for resort-style living. This spacious two-bedroom, one-bath condominium offers a thoughtfully designed open floor plan, ideal for both everyday living and effortless entertaining. Step out onto your private deck and take in serene, wooded views-your own tranquil retreat. Inside, recent updates shine throughout: brand-new custom cabinetry, complemented by sleek new appliances, plush carpeting, and a fresh coat of paint that enhances the home's bright and inviting atmosphere. A full-size washer and dryer are conveniently located in-unit, while additional storage space is available in the basement. Parking is never an issue, with abundant spaces for residents and guests in addition to your dedicated parking spot. Perfectly positioned near the Stamford train station and just minutes from local beaches-including scenic Cove Island Park-this residence blends modern comfort with an unbeatable location. Welcome home to Heywood Heights.
